title: CLEAR: Structured Specifications for Controllable Long-Horizon ML Research Engineering
title_zh: CLEAR：用于可控长时程机器学习研究工程的结构化规范

paragraphs.en: CLEAR提出结构化规范，帮助LLM智能体在长时程机器学习研究工程中保持一致表征。 Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being used to automate machine learning (ML) research workflows, ranging from code development and experiment execution to research reproduction and scientific discovery. Recent systems demonstrate that LLMs can perform substantial portions of ML research engineering with limited human intervention. These advances suggest a shift from automating individual research tasks toward automating long-horizon workflows that transform research artifacts into executable ML systems. However, ML research engineering remains substantially more difficult than isolated code generation. A research artifact typically specifies a system only implicitly through a mixture of natural-language descriptions, equations, pseudo-code, implementation details, datasets, and evaluation protocols. An agent must first infer the intended computational structure, translate it into executable components, coordinate their dependencies, and repeatedly diagnose and repair failures during execution. Consequently, the quality of the final system depends not only on code generation, but also on whether the agent can maintain a consistent representation of what should be implemented throughout this long-horizon process.
paragraphs.zh: CLEAR提出结构化规范，帮助LLM智能体在长时程机器学习研究工程中保持一致表征。大语言模型（LLM）智能体正被越来越多地用于自动化机器学习（ML）研究工作流，涵盖代码开发、实验执行、研究复现与科学发现等多个环节。 近期的研究系统表明，LLM能够在极少人工干预的情况下完成机器学习研究工程的相当大一部分工作。 这些进展表明，研究正从自动化单个研究任务转向自动化长时程工作流，即将研究产物转化为可执行的机器学习系统。 然而，机器学习研究工程远比孤立的代码生成困难得多。 研究产物通常只通过自然语言描述、公式、伪代码、实现细节、数据集和评估协议的混合形式来隐式地规定一个系统。 智能体必须首先推断出预期的计算结构，将其转化为可执行的组件，协调各组件之间的依赖关系，并在执行过程中反复诊断和修复故障。 因此，最终系统的质量不仅取决于代码生成，还取决于智能体能否在这一长时程过程中对应当实现的内容保持一致的表征。
